title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for pressure ulcer.

HPI: The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a follow-up evaluation of a pressure ulcer located over the sacrum. He reports that the area has been improving well since his last visit. He denies any new pain, drainage, or discomfort in the area.

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10 mg daily
- Atorvastatin 20 mg daily

Exam: The patient is alert and oriented. Physical examination of the sacral region reveals that the pressure ulcer has completely healed. The skin is intact, smooth, and shows no signs of breakdown. There is no redness or irritation noted.

Assessment: 1. Pressure ulcer of the sacrum. The wound is now fully healed.

Plan: Since the pressure ulcer has healed, no further treatment or interventions are required at this time. The patient was instructed to continue using pressure-relieving surfaces to maintain skin integrity. Follow-up is not necessary unless new concerns arise.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, PA-C, 05/14/2026
explanations: A pressure ulcer documented as completely healed is not coded.

distractors.why: No code is assigned for a completely healed pressure ulcer.
